name: A Strange Request
summary: Witch Doctor Uzer'i needs a concoction that Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar has mixed up. Uzer'i hands you a shrunken head, promised to Neeru in exchange for the herbs, and sends you to the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar to deliver it.

sections.title: A Promised Payment
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i says Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar has what is needed to get started in Feralas: a concoction for something Uzer'i will not yet explain. Uzer'i gives you a shrunken head, promised to Neeru in return for the herbs. It is the head of some poor dwarf Uzer'i came across in the forest. Neeru can be found in the Cleft of Shadow.

sections.title: Neeru's Herbs
sections.body: Neeru Fireblade has been waiting for Uzer'i to make this delivery, and hands over the herb mixture prepared for Uzer'i's experiments.

faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i, who has you take a shrunken head to Orgrimmar.
In the Cleft of Shadow, in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Whose head is the shrunken head?
faq.answer: Uzer'i calls it the head of some poor dwarf, come across in the forest.

faq.q: Why does Uzer'i send a shrunken head to Neeru?
aliases: why does neeru want the head
faq.answer: Uzer'i promised it to Neeru in exchange for the herbs, and needs the concoction Neeru has mixed up.
The chain goes on with Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i.
